div.div: هُوَ مَغْمُوصٌ عَلَيْهِ He is censured, or blamed, or reproached, (S, K,) with respect to his religion, (S, A, K,) and with respect to his grounds of pretension to respect. (A.) It is said in a trad., إِلَّا مَغْموصٌ عَلَيْهِ النِّفَاقُ, meaning, Except one censured, &c., with respect to his religion; accused, or suspected, of hypocrisy. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
